output.summary: KEP-4004 deprecates the status.nodeInfo.kubeProxyVersion field of v1.Node and has kubelet stop setting it (set to empty string instead), protected by a feature gate. Status is implemented with the feature gate disabled by default.
output.rationale: The field is inaccurate because kubelet sets it but does not know the kube-proxy version or whether kube-proxy runs. The KEP marks it deprecated and has kubelet write an empty string, using a feature gate until other components stop depending on it. Default-enabling was delayed because the field is in a stable API, so the removal period from the 1.29 announcement had to pass (liggitt's comment).

alternatives.why_not: Listed as a non-goal; components should not infer Service features from the kube-proxy version because some clusters run alternative service proxies.

alternatives.option: Change v1.Node validation to require the field be unset
alternatives.why_not: Listed as a non-goal in the KEP.

alternatives.option: Promote to beta and default-enable in 1.31
alternatives.why_not: liggitt noted that clearing a stable API field requires a minimum one-year period from the 1.29 announcement, so 1.33 was the earliest default-on; the 1.31 enablement was reverted.

evidence.quote: The proposal is to deprecate the `kubeProxyVersion` field of `NodeStatus`, and to have kubelet set it to an empty string, rather than the kubelet version, in the future.
Thus, we will use a feature gate to protect it until all components are fixed.
because this is clearing population of a stable API field, the minimum period from announcement (in 1.29) is 1 year, so 1.33 is the earliest this can default to clearing.
I think it would stay as-is for 1.32 and default-enable in 1.33
the Feature Gates status has already been updated in PR https://github.com/kubernetes/website/pull/50783
